newsitem.title: GERMANY: Telekom shares higher after 1996 figures.
newsitem.headline: Telekom shares higher after 1996 figures.

text.p: Shares in Deutsche Telekom convincingly out-performed the overall IBIS DAX index in pre-bourse trade on Monday after the company reported better-than-expected 1996 business figures.
Telekom shares were up 39 pfennigs, or 1.28 percent, at 31.63 marks, compared to the overall IBIS DAX index which was up 18.32 points, or 0.61 percent, at 3,025.19 points.

Earlier, Telekom said in a statement that sales grew to more than 63 billion marks, that it would pay as promised a dividend of 60 pfennigs per share on 1996 results and that it had cut debt by 10 billion marks.
